description: Short real-run smoke for 18_sela: pretrain -> encoder.pt -> linear_eval, one epoch on tiny real-shaped ImageFolder data. Discovered and driven by tests/test_real_run_smoke.py and bin/matrix-run.py (docs/REAL_RUN_VERIFICATION.md steps 2-3). Lives in the method's own directory so no shared file names a method. The override keys match this method's config schema (train.image_size, not img_size); train.k (the number of self-labelling clusters) is shrunk so Sinkhorn-Knopp assigns a few images into a few clusters.
